projectDescription: A proof-of-concept downgrade attack (CVE-2025-48804) that gains access to BitLocker-encrypted disks on fully patched Windows 11 machines by exploiting a signed pre-patch boot manager via USB or PXE boot.
keyFeatures: Boot manager downgrade attack exploiting CVE-2025-48804
USB boot delivery method (FAT32 stick, no extra tooling)
PXE boot delivery method via dnsmasq on Linux
patch_sdi.py script to build a custom boot.sdi with a replaced WIM
parse_sdi.py script to validate and inspect SDI file structure
Works on TPM-only and PCR 7+11 configurations while PCA 2011 is trusted
Pre-built boot_patched.sdi release with cmd.exe as WinRE launch app
publicApiSurface: USB directory layout: USB/EFI/Boot/bootx64.efi, USB/EFI/Microsoft/Boot/BCD, USB/sdi/boot_patched.sdi
PXE directory layout: TFTP-root/bootmgfw.efi, TFTP-root/Boot/BCD, TFTP-root/sdi/boot_patched.sdi
